about: The rulings dev/rosters/external_lists.py needs before `generate` may write the difficulty mod's and Apotheosis's
own lists (config/iridescent_difficulty-common.toml, config/apotheosis/adventure.cfg, three distros) from the registry.
A null is a ruling still owed: `generate` refuses while any value it needs is null; `check` uses every ruled value.
RULED 2026-10-16 (operator, in the ruling-25 chat, each the recommended option): bosses with a designed health or
the x3 leave the curve, the Elder Guardian stays excluded as before (`Designed bosses`); every registry dimension at
its registry tier on the curve (`Registry tier`); rarities: the Frost World the Abyss's, the Abyss pocket tier 2's,
tier 4 the End's (`Tier ladder`); boss spawns on the Frost World (the Abyss's) and the 5 planets (8 %), none in the
orbits, the three pocket dimensions or the Reality Marble (`Planets + Frost World`). The Aether's values are the
Aether-to-tier-4 ruling's (design/scope-aether-to-tier-4-2026-10-15.md section 8, chip A), taken as given.
difficulty.excludes.scope: the registry system whose entries leave the dimension curve, with their second ids, or a
list of systems (an entry held by any of them); false = the list is not generated. keep: ids kept on the list that
the scope does not hold (each a registered entity type).
difficulty.dimensions.registryTiers: true = every registry dimension on the curve at its registry tier, except
tierOf (another tier on the curve) and leaveOff (left off: the curve gives it t1); false = t1..t4 not generated.
apotheosis.<list>.dimensions: the value of one dimension (the ten real dimensions: today's values, copied 2026-10-15);
tiers: the value of a registry tier, for every dimension without its own; leaveOff: dimensions left off that list.
Unlisted in Apotheosis 7.4.8 (bytecode): no rarity clamp (the whole ladder by weight) and no boss spawns.
